name: carousel
title: Carousel
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A carousel for cycling through slides (images, cards, or any content) with keyboard, swipe, and button navigation. Built on embla-carousel-react; CarouselPrevious/CarouselNext are Buttons wired to the carousel API. `autoplay` (`true` or `{ delay }`, 5000 ms by default) advances on its own and wraps to the first slide; pair it with `CarouselAutoplayToggle` (pause/resume, required for moving content by WCAG 2.2.2; a dev warning flags its absence). Rotation pauses while the pointer is over the carousel or focus is inside it, starts paused under reduced motion, and slide changes are announced (`aria-live`) only when not rotating. `CarouselDots` shows one dot per slide, marks the current one and goes to a slide on press. The toggle and dots are not positioned; place them where they fit. Built-in labels are in English; translate them with `i18n.labels`.
